260:t_005:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...$$ＷＩＬＬ$$, run a simulation for our retreat.」

260:t_005:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah! Are you telling us to show our backs to the enemy!?」

260:t_005:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We are not in a situation where we can fight to the very last moment, then return to base for repairs.」

260:t_005:12.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Even if we win here, if we take damage, the next battle will be the end of us.」

260:t_005:13.en:
$n
「So that's... what fighting in space means...」

260:t_005:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's not it...! The moment we show these guys our backs, they'll jump us and call it their lucky day. I know they will...!」

260:t_005:19.en:
$$甲児$$
「Isn't it obvious!? We go all out and push forward!」

260:t_005:20.en:
$$甲児$$
「And then we hit them so thoroughly they never think about laying a hand on us again!!」

260:t_006:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$マジンガー$$ is ablaze!」

260:t_006:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is the Photon Power reacting to $$甲児$$'s fighting spirit!」

260:t_007:1.en:
$$ボス$$
「Even out in space like this!?」

260:t_008:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Did you call me, warriors of steel!」

260:t_008:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Your courage, your fighting spirit... and your hope called me once more!」

260:t_008:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You! You should have spent all your power and fallen into eternal sleep in the gap between dimensions...!」

260:t_008:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「As long as there is hope in the world, the light will dwell once more! $$ゼウス$$, the god of that light, is eternal!」

260:t_008:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Come now! Younger brothers and sisters of light! Let us fight these fiends together!!」

260:t_009:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Power is surging through my heart and body!!」

260:t_009:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That is the power of hope! The guidepost to the future that those who hold the power of life carry within!」

260:t_009:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Curse you, $$ゼウス$$!! You raise your sword against us yet again!?」

260:t_009:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「You are not the only ones I fight! It is all the darkness of this world!」

260:t_009:7.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Let us fight together, warriors of steel!」

260:t_009:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We advance with everything we have! Our guidepost is hope!」

260:t_009:12.en:
$n
「Hope is our guidepost, huh. Not bad!」

260:t_009:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go! Anyone who blocks our way, I'll beat them down and push through!!」

260:t_010:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「For a while I wondered how this would turn out, but we managed to pull through.」

260:t_010:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「This, too, is probably thanks to the power of $$ゼウス神#pilot$$.」

260:t_010:3.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「No, that is not so. It was because the light called hope was in your hearts.」

260:t_010:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$兜甲児$$... and $$マジンガーＺ$$. I was glad to meet you again.」

260:t_010:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Ah! Wait, $$ゼウス$$! We've got a favor to ask!」

260:t_010:7.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Humanity must carve out its own path. As your elder brother, I can only watch over you.」

260:t_010:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Cheapskate! Don't you know the saying 'When in trouble, pray to the gods'!?」

260:t_010:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-I'm so sorry! I'll give these kids a good talking-to later!」

260:t_010:11.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「No, never mind! To tell the truth, this $$ゼウス$$ doesn't mind being relied upon at all!」

260:t_010:14.en:
$$青山$$
(Come to think of it, he came to help us without being asked, both in the $$時獄戦役$$ and in today's battle...)

260:t_010:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh, then! $$ノノ$$ wants a $$バスターマシン$$ of her ow...」

260:t_010:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$... We ran into trouble and got jumped to the center of this galaxy.」

260:t_010:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「But we have something we have to do on Earth.」

260:t_010:19.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Say no more, $$兜甲児$$. ...It's the fight against them, isn't it?」

260:t_010:20.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Then I, $$ゼウス$$, will send you to Earth with what power I have left now!」

260:t_011:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「No thanks are needed, brother. We are comrades who stand together against the crisis closing in on the universe.」

260:t_011:3.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「You will come to know it in time. When that time comes, I...」

260:t_013:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No matter how you look at it... this isn't near Earth.」

260:t_013:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What the heck! Did $$ゼウス$$ fail!?」

260:t_013:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Something seemed to happen to $$ゼウス$$ back then, but...」
